Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 240, "amount_cents": 8145}, {"order_id": 243, "amount_cents": 13498}, {"order_id": 245, "amount_cents": 10428}]

hold_reason: Refunds table does not match Alpha Co's report. list_refunds returned no refunds, but W2 reported three applied refunds: order 240 (8145 cents), order 243 (13498 cents), and order 245 (10428 cents). Paying out before this is reconciled could overpay customers, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs human review of the shared ledger before any payouts are recorded.
